name: qa_cpu_wt
title: OS-CEWTENV W3a (3.10): the CPU of the cutoff WT Env on the unit in three arms, one run per `--var PROJ=` (Dense8 no WT, Dense8wt6 6 voices no warps, Dense8wt12 12 voices both warps +7/+7; the arms are made by hil/gen_wt_arms.py into build-sdtest/): opened from File, `cpu reset`, Play, 24 reads of `cpu` 2.5 s apart over 60 s, then on a bench image `bench worst` and `bench wt`. ASSERTS underrun 0 and guard shed 0 at every read; the mean is reported

steps.say: OS-CEWTENV W3a (3.10): the CPU of the cutoff WT Env on the unit, three arms, one per run: `--var PROJ=Dense8` (no WT, the baseline), `PROJ=Dense8wt6` (6 voices, cutoff WT Env, no warps) or `PROJ=Dense8wt12` (12 voices, cutoff WT Env, both warps +7/+7). BEFORE the run: make the arms (`python3 -I platform/mk66/tools/hil/gen_wt_arms.py <Dense8 folder> <out>`, the folders land in build-sdtest/) and copy ONE arm folder into Projects/ on the card (card reader or the unit's USB Disk mode). Use the release image for `cpu`, then the bench image (-DO3OS_BENCH=ON, mk66-bench) of the same build id for `bench worst` and `bench wt` (cpu-budget.md section 5).
